description: 행정안전부_공유플랫폼_하천정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부에서 운영하는 재난안전데이터 공유플랫폼( safetydata. go. kr)에서 제공하는 하천 정보로, 하천관리번호, 하천명, 본류, 지류, 수계코드, 하천등급코드. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 하천, 하천경계, 홍수, 지점관리, 환경부. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
